question: Together, A and B can finish a piece of work in 12, B and C in 20, while C and A can finish it in 15. Together, A, B, and C can finish it in?
solution:
**Given:**

A and B can finish a piece of work in 12 days.

B and C can finish the same work in 20 days.

C and A can finish the same work in 15 days.

Work done in 1 day by two parties = 1 / (time taken by two parties together).

Total work = LCM of times taken by all parties together.
